In [[geometry]], the '''metagyrate diminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|78}}}}). It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with one [[pentagonal cupola]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|5}}}}) rotated through 36 [[Degree (angle)|degree]]s, and a non-opposing pentagonal cupola removed. (The cupolae cannot be adjacent.)
